says: pnpm lint:dead (code-graph 0.15.0) flags a helper in a *.test-support.ts file that only tests call as only-called-from-tests, because its default testSupportFilePatterns do not list *.test-support.ts, the repo's place for test helpers (0538); helpers already there pass only when their name also appears in some product file.
proof: On fabrikalfa/mock-lib-top-s1 at 8d92196df, pnpm -s lint:dead prints 'only-called-from-tests next/packages/libfabrika/src/Id.test-support.ts:generatorWith'. code-graph dist/index.js:2095 sets the default patterns, and node-kinds.json, which lint:dead passes, sets none.
cost: A new test-support helper with an uncommon name fails pnpm lint, and 0524 allows no ledger row, so generatorWith blocks lint until this is decided.
